comment: Runner profiles for scripts/swarm_runner.py (fix plan Item 21, Amendment 1). Values are fleet-shape defaults from the plan; per-host overrides live in <openclaw-data>/skill71-runner-profile.json and win over detection. Capabilities describe host swarm-grade provisioning: when a capability is absent the runner declares the sequential fallback in the run record instead of failing items (Amendment 6).

fleet-contabo.comment: One Contabo server sliced into per-client containers. The KIE limiter state is per KIE account, not per container: a deployment whose containers share one KIE account must point kie_limiter_path at a path shared by those containers (for example {shared}/kie-limiter-<account>.json via the per-host override file), so the 20 starts per 10 seconds hold across the box, not per container.
